items.title: Charles Schwab's Sonders Favors Commodities Over Equities, But Not for All
items.summary: Schwab's Liz Ann Sonders says the firm is neutral on equities and favors commodities, with no universal portfolio fit.

items.title: Bond Rout Spurs Record Outflow From $3.6 Billion Schwab Muni ETF
items.summary: A roughly $3.6 billion municipal-bond exchange-traded fund is careening toward its biggest monthly outflow ever, after a fixed-income selloff pushed muni yields to the highest in months.

items.title: SCHW Client Assets Hit $13.41T in August: Will the Momentum Continue?
items.summary: Schwab's record $64.8 billion in August core net new assets and $13.41 trillion in client assets highlight strong momentum across its platform.

items.title: The Next Phase of Webull Could Be the One That Matters Most
items.summary: Webull just posted a record trading quarter, eliminated a regulatory headwind it called its defining moment, and closed a major international acquisition, yet the stock is down 34% over the past year. Whether the next phase of its story corrects that or deepens it depends on a few things falling into place.

items.title: ‘We Asked ChatGPT and It Said to Realize Gains’: But CFP Wes Moss Says Don’t Withdraw a Dime
items.summary: A Texas family used ChatGPT to build an income plan around a brokerage account, and a certified financial planner stopped them before they made a move that would have triggered taxes they never needed to pay.

items.title: Charles Schwab (SCHW) Brings AI Tools to 16,000 Financial Advisors
items.summary: Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) is partnering with Anthropic to roll out the Claude for Financial Advisors tool to its RIA network. The AI assistant is being integrated into the workflows of more than 16,000 independent advisors that custody with Schwab. Claude is expected to support tasks such as drafting client communications, summarizing documents, and assisting with research for advisory teams. items.title: Anthropic Just Put Claude Inside Schwab and BlackRock. The AI Agent War Has Reached Wealth Management
items.summary: Anthropic pushed Claude directly into wealth-management workflows on September 14, launching Claude for Financial Advisors with connections to Charles Schwab, BlackRock and other industry platforms. It lets advisers pull client and portfolio information into Claude for meeting prep, portfolio review and documentation. items.title: Arbitration Panel Orders Schwab to Pay $1.3 Million for Failing to Spot Elder Fraud in Crypto Scam
items.summary: Schwab acknowledges the now-deceased client’s losses but says it shouldn’t have been responsible for reimbursing his sons.
